dedupe_keys.name: impact of integrated wind farm control on frequency support services

description: Popa, Mara-Ioana and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. A MATLAB/Simulink and FLORIS implementation combines plant control with wake steering for a four-turbine, 15 MW-per-turbine reference farm at five-diameter spacing. Fast and containment reserve controllers are tuned to Nordic synchronous-area requirements. Simulated wind regimes, gusts and yaw settings test activation timing and power gain. The source identifies limits near cut-in speeds. Results describe this simulation configuration, not certification or physical deployment of a grid-service controller. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The implementation is based on the combination of MATLAB/Simulink plant control with FLORIS wake modelling.
